prompt: Black learns to share the red truck
title: Red Truck, Our Truck
irony: Black keeps the red truck all to himself to have all the fun, but the truck is only fun when everyone takes a turn.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Moon glows over the quiet street as a shiny red truck sits under the lamp.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Black hugs the red truck tight and tells Navy and Jade it is only his racer.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Navy asks for a turn and Jade dares a race, but Black blocks the truck and shouts no.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The three kids chant round the red truck while Black pulls it back from reaching hands.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Black zooms the truck alone down the curb, tips it over, and its small wheel sticks fast.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: All three tug the stuck red truck at once and spin down in a giggling heap.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The three kids chant round the tipped red truck while nobody can make it roll.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lilac kneels by the truck in the lamplight and softly recalls hoarding treats as a girl.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lilac smiles, sets a turn-taking rule, and shows small hands pushing together.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Black and Navy push the red truck together round the square while Jade cheers them on.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The friends trade turns with the red truck under the moon, laughing as it rolls far.
